abstract: Here we study the core entropy function $h: PM(d) \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ defined on the space of degree $d$ primitive majors, a combinatorial model for the space of degree $d$ polynomials. In particular, we introduce techniques to classify the global maximum for each $d$ and the maxima along certain strata. We show that there are $d-1$ global maxima over all of $PM(d)$ and that the maxima on the unicritical stratum is a Cantor set.
title: Maximizing Core Entropy
